mapper.sql: id, create_user_id, create_user_name, create_time, update_user_id, update_user_name, update_time, version, is_deleted, code, approve_status, type, data_json, remark
mapper.select: SELECT m.id, m.create_user_id, m.create_user_name, m.create_time, m.update_user_id, m.update_user_name, m.update_time, m.version, m.is_deleted, m.type, m.data_json, m.remark FROM message m WHERE not EXISTS (SELECT * FROM message_user_read mur WHERE mur.message_id = m."id" AND mur.user_id = #{userId})
